WC04 Camera 0.1.2 - EXPERIMENTAL

Compiled and host-tested. The previous build received valid UVC headers but
no image payload at either resolution. This version initializes negotiation
from camera-provided parameters instead of zeroing all probe fields.
GET_MAX is tried first, then GET_DEF and GET_CUR if needed. All exchanges
are logged. This is a candidate compatibility fix, pending hardware testing.
Successful photo capture and Photo Channel playback remain unverified.

Copy apps/wc04-camera to the SD root's apps directory. Requires a WC04
(057e:030a), writable FAT SD card, Wii Remote, and Homebrew Channel on IOS58.
The app does not install or reload IOS and does not write to NAND.

2: scan / log descriptors
1: toggle 320x240 and 640x480
A: capture; after saving, A opens the preview
B: cancel capture; A/B leaves the preview
HOME: exit

Photos: sd:/DCIM/100WC04/WC04####.JPG (existing files are not overwritten)
Log: sd:/wc04-camera/session.log (appended)

Logs include the Wii clock and monotonic elapsed seconds with milliseconds.
The Wii clock may be inaccurate; elapsed time does not depend on it.
Timeout, B, and exit requests are identified separately. A USB completion
after a stop request is recorded separately from an earlier USB failure.

Reconnect the camera before launching this build to start a fresh test.
Please test A at the default 320x240 without pressing B (up to 10 seconds),
then test 640x480. Finally try B during a separate capture. Exit normally
and return session.log with the steps taken and any saved test photo.
Packet samples are written after capture, avoiding SD writes in reception.
If both resolutions still receive only headers, please also report whether
this camera produces a live picture on a computer with a standard webcam app.

There is no live viewfinder. Photographs are re-encoded as baseline JPEGs.
After exiting, try viewing them through the Photo Channel's SD-card option.

If cancellation waits for USB completion, unplug the camera. A wedged IOS
control request may require restarting the console. This is a prototype.

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.
See licenses/ for the application and third-party notices.
